title: coverage
description: Which blocks a flow describes a use for, from describe coverage, or for one flow with describe coverage --flow <id>: every block in a bucket, visited, touched or dark. The numbers are not a target.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always Coverage, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: Every block's bucket, the counts and the flows read.

blocks.description: One per block, in the design's order.

group.description: The title of the group it sits in, else the group's id; absent outside any group.

bucket.description: What the flows do with it, an open word. Known words: visited: a step stands on it; touched: a step writes into it or sends to it without the request going there; dark: no flow names it.

visitedBy.description: The flows that visit it, in flow order.

touchedBy.description: The flows that touch it without visiting it, in flow order.

unclaimed.description: It names no service and could, since it is not outside the system.

actor.description: Its kind is one the design casts as outside the system, a caller rather than part of it.

counts.description: How many blocks in each bucket.

flows.description: The ids of the flows read: every flow, or the one asked for.
